independent_reference.source: Wiscombe, Improved Mie scattering algorithms, Appl. Opt. 19:1505 (1980), MIEV0 lossless test case (r=0.525 um, lambda=632.8 nm => x=5.21282, m=1.55; quote all 6 figures of x, spec section 4 E'); miepython reproduces the same table; lossless => ext==sca self-check asserted in tests.

Wiscombe MIEV0 x=100 absorbing case. SIGN-CONVENTION TRAP (spec section 4 E', hit live at v0.2 verification): Wiscombe's m=1.5-1i is the e^{+iwt} convention; this table (Bohren & Huffman e^{-iwt}) uses m=1.5+1i or the absorber becomes gain and Q_sca blows up.

Rayleigh small-particle limit Q_sca = (8/3)*x^4*|(m^2-1)/(m^2+2)|^2 (van de Hulst, Light Scattering by Small Particles, section 6.4; B&H section 5.1) — independent closed-form anchor for the series at x -> 0, agreement asserted in tests.
